_comment: Every statement Morrow sends to Relate. The app fetches this file at boot and shows the matching text in its inspector and Cypher log; scripts/verify_queries.py runs the same file against store/morrow with the Relate CLI, so a statement that works in the app and one that works in the CLI cannot drift apart.

read.obligations:
MATCH (o:Obligation)
RETURN o.id AS id, o.title AS title, o.due AS due, o.minutes AS minutes,
       o.channel AS channel, o.stake AS stake, o.brief AS brief, o.status AS status
ORDER BY o.due
read.artifacts:
MATCH (a:Artifact)
RETURN a.id AS id, a.title AS title, a.kind AS kind, a.status AS status,
       a.minutes_left AS minutes_left, a.text AS text
read.needs:
MATCH (o:Obligation)-[n:NEEDS]->(a:Artifact)
RETURN o.id AS obligation, a.id AS artifact, n.weight AS weight
read.depends:
MATCH (a:Artifact)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(b:Artifact)
RETURN a.id AS artifact, b.id AS on
read.leverage:
MATCH (o:Obligation)-[n:NEEDS]->(a:Artifact)
WHERE o.status = 'open' AND a.status <> 'ready'
WITH a, collect(DISTINCT o.title) AS deadlines
WHERE size(deadlines) >= 2
RETURN a.id AS id, a.title AS artifact, a.minutes_left AS minutes, a.status AS status,
       size(deadlines) AS claims, deadlines
ORDER BY claims DESC, minutes DESC
read.collisions:
MATCH (o:Obligation)
WHERE o.status = 'open'
WITH o.due AS day, collect(o.title) AS titles
WHERE size(titles) >= 2
RETURN day, size(titles) AS n, titles
ORDER BY day
read.artifactClaims:
MATCH (a:Artifact {id: $id})<-[n:NEEDS]-(o:Obligation)
RETURN o.title AS deadline, o.due AS due, o.status AS status, n.weight AS share
ORDER BY due
read.artifactRipple:
MATCH (a:Artifact {id: $id})<-[:NEEDS]-(o:Obligation)-[:NEEDS]->(sib:Artifact)
WHERE sib.id <> $id
RETURN o.title AS deadline, collect(DISTINCT sib.title) AS also_needed
ORDER BY deadline
read.artifactDeps:
MATCH (a:Artifact {id: $id})-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..3]->(d:Artifact)
RETURN d.title AS needs_first, d.status AS status
read.artifactDownstream:
MATCH (a:Artifact)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..3]->(b:Artifact {id: $id})
RETURN a.title AS feeds, a.status AS status
read.obligationNeeds:
MATCH (o:Obligation {id: $id})-[n:NEEDS]->(a:Artifact)
RETURN a.title AS artifact, a.status AS status, a.minutes_left AS minutes_left, n.weight AS share
ORDER BY minutes_left DESC
read.obligationShared:
MATCH (o:Obligation {id: $id})-[:NEEDS]->(a:Artifact)<-[:NEEDS]-(other:Obligation)
WHERE other.id <> $id
RETURN a.title AS artifact, collect(DISTINCT other.title) AS also_claimed_by
read.similar:
MATCH (a:Artifact)
SEARCH a IN (VECTOR INDEX artifact_brief FOR $vec LIMIT $k) SCORE AS score
MATCH (o:Obligation)-[:NEEDS]->(a)
WHERE o.status = 'open'
RETURN a.id AS id, a.title AS artifact, round(score, 3) AS score,
       a.status AS status, a.minutes_left AS minutes_left,
       collect(DISTINCT o.id) AS deadline_ids, collect(DISTINCT o.title) AS deadlines
ORDER BY score DESC
read.unblocks:
MATCH (a:Artifact {id: $id})<-[:NEEDS]-(o:Obligation)-[:NEEDS]->(sib:Artifact)
WHERE o.status = 'open' AND sib.id <> $id
RETURN a.title AS artifact, o.title AS deadline, o.due AS due,
       collect(DISTINCT sib.title) AS still_needed
ORDER BY due

write.markReady: MATCH (a:Artifact {id: $id}) SET a.status = 'ready', a.minutes_left = 0 RETURN a.title AS title
write.addDeadline: CREATE (:Obligation {id: $id, title: $title, due: $due, minutes: $minutes, status: 'open', channel: $channel, stake: '', brief: $brief})
write.addArtifact: CREATE (:Artifact {id: $id, title: $title, kind: $kind, status: $status, minutes_left: $minutes_left, text: $text, vec: $vec})
write.addObligationSeed: CREATE (:Obligation {id: $id, title: $title, due: $due, minutes: $minutes, status: 'open', channel: $channel, stake: $stake, brief: $brief})
